trials.claimQuote: Lifetime access to VanChat - All future Startup Plan updates - If Plan name changes, deal will be mapped to the new Plan name with all accompanying updates
trials.reasoning: The binding terms let the vendor alter or discontinue the services at its discretion without prior notice, which materially limits the lifetime access promise despite a review calling it a lifetime deal.

exhibits.quote: We may alter or discontinue the Website or its Services at our discretion, without prior notice.
exhibits.argument: Vendor reserves unilateral right to discontinue services without notice, undermining lifetime access promise.

exhibits.quote: Terminate or suspend your access to all or part of the Website for any violation of these Terms of Use.
exhibits.argument: Vendor can terminate or suspend access for violations, limiting unconditional lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: We see VanChat keep improving day by day, and we cannot find alternative for the lifetime deal chatbot as good as VanChat.
exhibits.argument: Reviewer confirms they purchased VanChat as a lifetime deal chatbot and find it unmatched.

trials.claim: Plan 1 includes 300 GPT replies per month, 50 data sources, 1,000 products
trials.claimQuote: 300 GPT replies per month - AI trains with 50 data sources - AI trains and recommends 1,000 products
trials.reasoning: The exhibits only say testing uses reply credits and the quota cannot be increased; they do not confirm or contradict the stated 300 replies, 50 data sources, or 1,000 products.

exhibits.quote: every single AI reply uses up a credit, even during setup and testing.
exhibits.argument: Testing and setup consume the 300-reply allowance, reducing usable monthly replies.

exhibits.quote: Currently, we do not have an option to increase the reply quota specifically for lifetime plans.
exhibits.argument: Support confirms no way to increase quota, making the fixed reply limit a hard cap.

trials.claim: Plan 2 includes 1,000 GPT replies per month, 100 data sources, 2,000 products
trials.claimQuote: 1,000 GPT replies per month - AI trains with 100 data sources - AI trains and recommends 2,000 products
trials.reasoning: The exhibits only say light testing quickly uses the allowance and the quota cannot be increased; they do not confirm or contradict the stated 1,000 replies, 100 data sources, or 2,000 products.

exhibits.quote: Within less than a day of light testing I had already burned through over 10% of my monthly allowance.
exhibits.argument: Light testing quickly exhausts allowance, undermining adequacy of 1,000 replies per month.

exhibits.quote: Currently, we do not have an option to increase the reply quota specifically for lifetime plans.
exhibits.argument: Support confirms no way to increase quota, making the fixed reply limit a hard cap.

trials.claimQuote: All future Startup Plan updates - If Plan name changes, deal will be mapped to the new Plan name with all accompanying updates
trials.reasoning: The terms allow modifying or discontinuing AI services, and a buyer notes AppSumo plans are distinct from advertised plans, creating uncertainty about receiving all future Startup Plan updates.

exhibits.quote: We reserve the right to modify or discontinue AI services at our discretion, subject to providing reasonable notice.
exhibits.argument: Vendor can modify or discontinue AI services, undermining promise of all future updates.

exhibits.quote: A downside is that the AppSumo plans are distinct from the advertised plans, which raises uncertainty about future updates once the tool moves beyond the AppSumo offering.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports AppSumo plans differ from advertised plans, creating uncertainty about future updates.

exhibits.quote: I did ask before I purchased if I would get future updates at the 'Growth Plan' level with a three-plan purchase and got a response of 'Yes, you'll get future updates' without mentioning the specific plan I would get updates for.
exhibits.argument: Reviewer confirms the vendor promised future updates for the purchase.
